arg · Λόγοϲ β̅ Περὶ τῶν τῆϲ γῆϲ διαφορῶν καὶ λίθων καὶ μεταλλικῶν καὶ τῆϲ ἀπὸ τῶν ζῴων ὠφελείαϲ, ἐκ τῶν ἁπλῶν Γαληνοῦ καὶ τοῦ περὶ τρο φῶν δυνάμεων αὐτοῦ καὶ Ὀριβαϲίου καὶ ἑτέρων. Ὅϲα μὲν φυτῶν ἐϲτι μόρια καὶ καρποὶ καὶ χυλοὶ καὶ ὀποὶ πρό ϲθεν εἴρηται· νυνὶ δὲ περὶ τῶν ὑπολοίπων φαρμάκων ὅϲα τῆϲ γῆϲ ἐϲτιν εἴδη καὶ ὅϲα μεταλλεύεται πρόκειται διελθεῖν, ἔπειτα καὶ περὶ ζῴων.

A.match_evidence: Notice heading: Venezia, Biblioteca Nazionale Marciana (BNM), gr. Z., 450 (coll. 0652); Diktyon 69921. Olivieri supplies neither date nor folios here; Pinakes adds s. 10 in. and Bibliotheca ff. 005-537v. Pinakes witness data: folios 005-537v, century 10 in..

No full match established. Searched Lavra Mss. Ω 63 and numeric catalogue 718. Ω 063 (Eustratiades 1873), Diktyon 28925, contains Aetius dated 1440 but gives ff. 001-543* and XVI books, against printed 346 folios and I–VIII. Η 063 (Eustratiades 0718), Diktyon 27735, is a Tetraeuangelium, s. 14. No notice establishes a renumbering from printed 718 to 1873. Candidates: https://pinakes.irht.cnrs.fr/notices/cote/28925/ and https://pinakes.irht.cnrs.fr/notices/cote/27735/. | [1] sign-off 2026-10-14: Pinakes 28925 = Lavra Ω 63 (Eustratiades 1873), Aetius, dated 1440 as Olivieri; Olivieri prints 718 Ω 63 (old number) and 346 ff.; Pinakes gives Aetius ff. 1-543*. Check build/pinakes_check/check.md.

Aᵗ.match_evidence: No full match established. Searched Lavra Mss. Ω 64 and numeric catalogue 719. Ω 064 (Eustratiades 1874), Diktyon 28926, contains Aetius, s. 18, against printed s. XIV and 362 folios. Η 064 (Eustratiades 0719), Diktyon 27736, is an Aland Gospel witness, not the described Aetius codex. No notice establishes a renumbering from printed 719 to 1874. Candidates: https://pinakes.irht.cnrs.fr/notices/cote/28926/ and https://pinakes.irht.cnrs.fr/notices/cote/27736/. | [1] sign-off 2026-10-14: candidate Pinakes 28926 = Lavra Ω 64 (Eustratiades 1874), Aetius, but dated s. XVIII against Olivieri s. XIV; left none.

B.match_evidence: Notice heading: Paris, Bibliothèque nationale de France (BNF), Grec, 2192; Diktyon 51821.  Pinakes witness data: folios 001--316v*, century 15.

C.match_evidence: Notice heading: Paris, Bibliothèque nationale de France (BNF), Grec, 1883; Diktyon 51509.  Pinakes witness data: folios 180v-720, century 14.

D.match_evidence: Notice heading: Athos, Μονή Βατοπεδίου, Mss., 0029; Diktyon 18176. Probable shelfmark equivalence: print A 29; Pinakes 0029, remark “olim 29”, with its bibliography explicitly naming “Athos Vatopedi A 29” (Calà 2023). Same monastery and Aetius I–V, VII–XVI. The A prefix is absent from the current heading. Pinakes dates it s. 15 / 1430 ca against printed s. XIV, and includes a further text at 420r-v against printed Ff. 419. Pinakes witness data: folios 001-419v, century 15, date 1430 ca.

E.match_evidence: Notice heading: Paris, Bibliothèque nationale de France (BNF), Grec, 2193; Diktyon 51822. Pinakes Aetius span 001-402* differs from printed ff. 1–399; its Africanus span 402--403v* differs from the printed allocation. The overall 403-folio extent is not replaced. Pinakes witness data: folios 001-402*, century 15.

F.match_evidence: Notice heading: Paris, Bibliothèque nationale de France (BNF), Grec, 2256; Diktyon 51886. Pinakes gives Aetius 034-142 and an additional excerpt at 562-565; print gives 34–194 for the two books. These are content spans, not a total-folio correction. Pinakes witness data: folios 034-142, century 15; folios 562-565, century 15.

G.match_evidence: Notice heading: Bologna, Biblioteca Universitaria, Mss., 3632; Diktyon 9761. The notice lists several Aetius excerpts but no Aetius span 71–90 as printed; no total extent is inferred from those spans. Pinakes witness data: folios 059-60v*, century 15; folios 114--125, 142--143, 233v--234v*, century 15; folios 139--171v, century 15; folios 172v-181, century 15.

H.match_evidence: Notice heading: Venezia, Biblioteca Nazionale Marciana (BNM), gr. Z., 289 (coll. 0627); Diktyon 69760. Pinakes s. 15 med. differs from printed s. circ. XVI; its Aetius span 002-332v does not establish the printed total Ff. 334. Pinakes witness data: folios 002-332v, century 15 med..

K.match_evidence: Notice heading: Paris, Bibliothèque nationale de France (BNF), Grec, 2191; Diktyon 51820. Pinakes Aetius 001-344* differs from printed 1–343; the notice continues to 375v, compatible with the printed total 375, not an independent total statement. Pinakes witness data: folios 001-344*, century 14.

L.match_evidence: Notice heading: Città del Vaticano, Biblioteca Apostolica Vaticana (BAV), Vat. gr., 2202; Diktyon 68833.  Pinakes witness data: folios 003-318v, century 14.

Lᵃ.match_evidence: Notice heading: Firenze, Biblioteca Medicea Laurenziana (BML), Plut., 75. 20; Diktyon 16705. Pinakes unit Folios 1-253 and s. 12, Aetius 003-255, with ff. 249-255 supplied in s. 16; print Ff. 256, first 248 s. XIV and remaining leaves perhaps s. XVI. These extent and main-date statements differ. Pinakes witness data: folios 003-255, century 12.

Lᵇ.match_evidence: Notice heading: Firenze, Biblioteca Medicea Laurenziana (BML), Plut., 75. 12; Diktyon 16697. Pinakes unit Folios 1-102 agrees numerically with printed Ff. 102; s. 15 differs from printed s. X (fortasse di¬ midii prioris). The surprising printed date is retained. Pinakes witness data: folios [not given], century 15.

M.match_evidence: Notice heading: Città del Vaticano, Biblioteca Apostolica Vaticana (BAV), Vat. gr., 1911; Diktyon 68540. Pinakes adds Aetius ff. 001-77v; Olivieri supplies no total foliation. Pinakes witness data: folios 001-77v, century 14.

Mᵉ.match_evidence: Notice heading: Messina, Biblioteca Regionale Universitaria 'Giacomo Longo', S.S. Salvatore, 084; Diktyon 40745.  Pinakes witness data: folios [not given], century 10.

Mᵒ.match_evidence: Notice heading: Venezia, Biblioteca Nazionale Marciana (BNM), gr. Z., 291 (coll. 0298); Diktyon 69762. Pinakes adds s. 15 in. to printed s. circiter XV. It gives Aetius 005-448v and 451r-v, with other texts on 449–450; no different total is inferred. Pinakes witness data: folios 005-448v, century 15 in.; folios 451r-v, century 15 in..

N.match_evidence: Notice heading: Città del Vaticano, Biblioteca Apostolica Vaticana (BAV), Vat. gr., 1904; Diktyon 68533. City, library and current shelfmark agree, but the notice describes Fragmenta miscellanea with units dated s. 09-16, s. 14 (2/2), s. 11 and no Aetius witness. It does not corroborate the printed Aetius codex dated 1306. Exact is a locator agreement only; witness identity remains doubtful. | [1] sign-off 2026-10-14: locator exact; the Pinakes notice lists no Aetius witness and different unit dates; link kept, content not corroborated.

O.match_evidence: Notice heading: Città del Vaticano, Biblioteca Apostolica Vaticana (BAV), Ott. gr., 311; Diktyon 65554. Pinakes narrows the printed open-ended Aetius f. 95 sqq. to 095v-100*; no different total is inferred. Pinakes witness data: folios 095v-100*, century 15-16.

P.match_evidence: Notice heading: Città del Vaticano, Biblioteca Apostolica Vaticana (BAV), Vat. gr., 0298; Diktyon 66929. tei/sigla.tsv says “Ottobonianus 298”; Praefatio prints Vaticanus gr. 298 (amendment 1). Pinakes unit Folios 001-599 does not enumerate printed I. 599 (+ 599ᵃ add.); Aetius date 1385-1389 agrees. Its main Aetius span starts 004, against printed a f. 1, and adds excerpt 598v. Pinakes witness data: folios 004-590v, century 14 ex., date 1385-1389; folios 598v, century 14 ex., date 1385-1389.

Pᵃ.match_evidence: Notice heading: Paris, Bibliothèque nationale de France (BNF), Supplément grec, 1240; Diktyon 53904. Pinakes Aetius century 12-19 differs from the printed s. XI for the parchment and recentissimae for the paper; the notice also dates the palimpsest witness at f. 229 to s. 08. No different total foliation is given. Pinakes witness data: folios [not given], century 12-19.

Pˣ.match_evidence: Notice heading: Città del Vaticano, Biblioteca Apostolica Vaticana (BAV), Pal. gr., 199; Diktyon 65931. Pinakes s. 13-14 (1300 ca.) expands printed s. XIII; Aetius 101-471* differs from printed 101–470. Its final witness extends 471-475*, without supplying a different total. Pinakes witness data: folios 101-471*, century 13-14, date 1300 ca.

Q.match_evidence: Notice heading: Venezia, Biblioteca Nazionale Marciana (BNM), gr. Z., 596 (coll. 0867); Diktyon 70067. Pinakes s. 14 (2/2) differs from printed s. circ. XV; Aetius 004-280 agrees in final folio with the printed 280, without being a total statement. Pinakes witness data: folios 004-280, century 14 (2/2).

R.match_evidence: Notice heading: Città del Vaticano, Biblioteca Apostolica Vaticana (BAV), Vat. gr., 0297; Diktyon 66928. Pinakes s. 14 is less precise than printed s. XIV ineunte; final contents end at 226 and do not separately enumerate printed preliminary III. Pinakes witness data: folios 001-225, century 14.

S.library: Real Biblioteca del Monasterio de San Lorenzo de El Escorial
S.date: s. XV; s. XIII; 21 m. Augusti 1298
S.match_evidence: Notice heading: Escorial, Real Biblioteca, Mss., Ψ. IV. 14 (Andrés 488); Diktyon 15259. Pinakes Aetius 001-370* differs from the printed parts 0ᵛ–45ʳ and 48–369ᵛ; century 13, 15 agrees broadly, but the 1298 colophon date is not repeated. Olivieri warns of faulty/repeated foliation; no reconciliation is inferred. Pinakes witness data: folios 001-370*, century 13, 15.

T.library: Real Biblioteca del Monasterio de San Lorenzo de El Escorial
T.match_evidence: Notice heading: Escorial, Real Biblioteca, Mss., Τ. II. 14 (Revilla 153); Diktyon 15425. Printed Latin T and Pinakes Greek Τ designate the same shelfmark; notice also has RBME identifier “T. II. 14”. Pinakes dates the Aetius witness to s. 15 against printed s. XVI and gives 199v-234 against printed 199–234. Pinakes witness data: folios 199v-234, century 15.

U.library: Real Biblioteca del Monasterio de San Lorenzo de El Escorial
U.match_evidence: Notice heading: Escorial, Real Biblioteca, Mss., Σ. III. 17 (Revilla 116); Diktyon 15387. Pinakes dates Aetius to s. 15 against printed s. XVI. Its Aetius spans 001-24v, 102-109v, 220-227v broadly cover the printed fragment locators; its separate Introductio spans 025-31v, 94-101v expand the printed 25=101ᵛ shorthand. Pinakes witness data: folios 001-24v, 102-109v, 220-227v, century 15.

V.match_evidence: Notice heading: Wien, Österreichische Nationalbibliothek (ÖNB), med. gr., 06; Diktyon 71031. Pinakes main date s. 13 differs from printed s. XV; it notes restoration of ff. 1, 3, 228 in the first half of s. 15. Aetius spans 003-272v, 273-275v and III do not corroborate printed total 732. Locator agreement does not resolve the extent discrepancy. Pinakes witness data: folios 003-272v, 273-275v, century 13; folios III, century 13.

Y.match_evidence: Notice heading: Paris, Bibliothèque nationale de France (BNF), Grec, 2198; Diktyon 51827. Pinakes date 1522 agrees with printed αφκβ (1522); Aetius 001-532v* stops before printed total 533 and says XVI books against printed XV. No total-folio correction is inferred. Pinakes witness data: folios 001-532v*, century 16, date 1522.

Z.match_evidence: Notice heading: Paris, Bibliothèque nationale de France (BNF), Supplément grec, 0630; Diktyon 53365. Pinakes s. 14 agrees; it gives no foliation to compare with printed 38. Pinakes witness data: folios [not given], century 14.

Notice heading: Paris, Bibliothèque nationale de France (BNF), Supplément grec, 0632; Diktyon 53367. Pinakes Aetius s. 19 differs from printed parchment ff. 3–298 s. XI; it gives no foliation or separate dating for the printed mixed-material parts. Pinakes witness data: folios [not given], century 19.

Pˣ¹.match_evidence: same codex as Pˣ (repeated witness designation); Notice heading: Città del Vaticano, Biblioteca Apostolica Vaticana (BAV), Pal. gr., 199; Diktyon 65931. Pinakes s. 13-14 (1300 ca.) expands printed s. XIII; Aetius 101-471* differs from printed 101–470. Its final witness extends 471-475*, without supplying a different total. Pinakes witness data: folios 101-471*, century 13-14, date 1300 ca.
